info.title: EyeWall API
info.description:
Hockey models built by [EyeWall Analytics](https://eyewallanalytics.com) for the NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL: Elo ratings, pre-game win probabilities, playoff odds, power rankings, player percentiles, projected lines, starting-goalie probabilities and a public scorecard of how the models have done.

**What's here.** Only numbers EyeWall produces. Box scores, play-by-play, rosters, standings and schedules belong to the leagues and aren't served here; responses carry league ids and team codes so you can join to those feeds yourself.

**Licence.** Data is [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): credit "EyeWall Analytics (eyewallanalytics.com)" wherever it appears. Each response's `meta.license` and `meta.attribution` say exactly what applies. Code is MIT ([github.com/ehlersio/eyewall-api](https://github.com/ehlersio/eyewall-api)).

**Limits.** 60 requests a minute per IP, no key needed. Responses are cached; most data changes once a night.

**Stability.** `/v1` only changes by adding things. A breaking change gets a `/v2`, and `/v1` keeps working for at least a full season after.

Probabilities are model estimates, not betting odds.

tags.description: Power rankings, with EyeWall AI's paragraph per team.

idSource.description: Where the league's team, game and player ids come from.

League.description: League id. NHL ids come from the NHL; PWHL, AHL and ECHL ids are HockeyTech ids.

source.description: Which EyeWall model or table the data comes from.

attribution.description: Credit line to show wherever the data appears.

generatedAt.description: When EyeWall produced this data (ISO 8601 date or timestamp), null when unknown.

allOf.description: PWHL only: the next regular season once it is scheduled. Null otherwise.

seasons.description: Seasons EyeWall has team data for, newest first.

CurrentSeason.description: The season EyeWall treats as current. For the PWHL this is the latest regular season until the next one starts.

SeasonType.description: HockeyTech season type. Null for the NHL, whose season id covers preseason, regular season and playoffs (game type is per game).

id.description: League team id (NHL team id, or HockeyTech team id).

homeAdvantage.description: Elo points added to the home team.

formula.example: P(home win) = 1 / (1 + 10^((awayRating - (homeRating + homeAdvantage)) / 400)); no home advantage at a neutral site

ratings.description: Current teams with a rating, highest first. A team with no games in EyeWall's replay yet (e.g. an expansion team before its first game) is left out.

gameType.description: NHL only; null for PWHL/AHL/ECHL (see the season's type).

loggedOn.description: The morning (America/New_York) the probability was logged. The last pre-game log is kept, and is what EyeWall's public scorecard grades.

GameTeam.description: A team in a game. Fields are null only for a team that is no longer current (e.g. relocated).

runDate.description: The nightly run these numbers come from.

stale.description: True when the latest run is older than expected (the nightly job missed a run).

format.description: PWHL/AHL/ECHL: the playoff format the simulation used, or "unverified".

playoffProbability.description: Share of simulations in which the team makes the playoffs. Null when the league hasn't published this season's playoff format.

divisionProbability.description: Share of simulations in which the team wins its division. Null where the format has no division title.

projectedPoints.description: Final standings points across the simulations.

eloRating.description: NHL only: the rating the simulation started from.

models.description: Keyed by model: gameWinner, startingGoalie, playoffOdds.

status.description: "ok", or "pending" before there is anything to grade.

baseline.description: A naive rule to beat, scored on the same predictions.

recent.description: The latest graded predictions (live grades only).

season.description: The season asked for; null when none was given (the latest run).

teams.description: Best first. Empty before the season's first run.

previousRank.description: Rank in the previous run; null on a team's first run.

PowerRankingComponentRanks.description: League rank (1 = best) in each part of the score: pts_pct (points percentage), l10_pts_pct (last 10 games), gd_pg (goal difference per game), special_teams.

season.description: The season asked for; null when none was given (the latest run).

allOf.description: Null before the season's first run.

narrative.description: EyeWall AI's paragraph on the team's ranking, in the requested language. Null when none was written for this run.

history.description: This season's recent runs, oldest first (up to 28).

rateBasis.description: What the rates are per, e.g. "perGP" (per game played) where the league publishes no ice time.

percentiles.description: Keyed by stat: goals, a1 (primary assists), penalties, finishing.

percentile.description: 0-100 rank against the league pool. Null when the player is below the sample floor or the stat has no data.

rateBasis.description: What the rates are per, e.g. "perGP" (per game played) where the league publishes no ice time.

goalsSavedAboveExpected.description: From EyeWall's danger-zone xG on the shots faced.

savePercentage.description: Save percentage by situation and danger zone, 0-100.

percentiles.description: Keyed by stat: gsax, gsax60, evSv, hdSv, mdSv, pkSv.

basis.description: "last_game": the last game's pairings, adjusted for who is out. "preseason": pooled preseason pairings before a team's first game. Null when there is no projection yet.

forwardLines.description: Left wing, center, right wing; top line first.

filledIn.description: True for a player who wasn't in the lineup the projection is based on (replacing an injured or moved player): the least certain part.

teams.description: Each team's goalies, most likely starter first.
